# `Q-3-52` — Table Not Supported in ANSI Format

> Table elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

## What this means

The ANSI writer (used when rendering to a terminal) does not
yet render tables. Faithful ANSI table rendering needs
column-width measurement against the terminal width and
multi-row layout decisions the writer does not yet make, so the
writer refuses rather than emit a broken approximation.

## Why this happens

Your document contains a table — a pipe table, a list-table, or
a fenced div with the `.table` class — and you rendered to ANSI
output.

## How to fix

Render to a different format. HTML, PDF, and the markdown
writers all handle tables. If you need a quick text view of the
data, render to markdown (`--to qmd`) and view that.

## Related

- `Q-3-50`, `Q-3-51`, `Q-3-53`, `Q-3-54`, `Q-3-55` — other
  block types the ANSI writer does not yet support.
